title: ÆTHER: Semma Paiyan (swaggering Tamil indie-pop breakup song with a Sufi-style chant, 1 min)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

positive_styles: playful, swaggering modern Tamil indie-pop breakup song: he brags he is the best guy she ever had and smiles through the hurt, peppy, catchy, a big singalong
D Phrygian dominant melody (D Eb F# G A Bb C), a Middle-Eastern Sufi-style colour, raga-shaped with fast slides, bends and melismatic turns
one steady 100 BPM bouncy groove from start to end, laid-back swing, handclaps on the off-beats, a cheeky triplet pickup at section ends

layered indie-pop production: a simple bouncy piano motif, a warm rubbery bass groove, a pop kick and snap, dry darbuka and frame-drum patterns with light tabla underneath, mandolin and a small brass section added one by one
a confident, cheeky young male voice singing in Tamil with clear diction, swagger, half-sung half-talked verses, playful English words
a powerful young female voice singing a soaring wordless Sufi-style melismatic chant hook (aa-aa, oh-oh) between his lines, close and natural
real instruments close and natural, no heavy echo
warm, bright, punchy modern mix
starts with the female chant and darbuka, piano and bass join by 3 s

brief.notes: Jithesh 30 Oct 19:01: the reference is the 'golden boy' song (Radhimaa, Aug 2026). v1 'Fine-u Dhaan Di' missed its two signatures: the swaggering self-praise refrain and the female Sufi-style chant. v2 keeps the indie-pop groove and adds both, with darbuka and handclaps. Original hook ('Semma paiyan naan da'), original melody, wordless chant only (no religious or Arabic words), nothing copied. Raga: Vakulabharanam / Phrygian dominant, Sa D.

story: A Chennai guy gets dumped by text on a Monday and brags he is the best guy she will ever find, smiling and dancing through the hurt, while a soaring female chant answers him. Twist: he accidentally likes her new photo.
human_work: to be added by the owner: melody, take choice, edits, mix
